description:
## Empirical signal (2026-05-05)

Arc 21 (commit e2d8b63) added 3 new templates to substrate/templates/ but did NOT update install.sh's TEMPLATE_NAMES deploy list. Result: re-installs at deployed tiers (workspace + sub-project) skipped the new templates entirely. User-tier POLYBIUS caught the gap during routine post-arc-21 propagation deploy verification — initial diff was suspiciously small (only 2 files modified instead of expected ~13+). Root cause: install.sh hardcodes TEMPLATE_NAMES; arc-21 added template files to source but missed wiring them into the deploy list.

Fixed inline at commit 51397da (3-line addition to TEMPLATE_NAMES). But the deeper gap is that arc-21's Phase C smoke beats checked template CONTENT (beats 7-8: 'fill template slots; verify polling-cron-prompt has 6 STEPs', 'fill autonomous-mode-activation slots; verify resulting paste names 6 setup steps') but did not check whether install.sh actually deploys the file. Smoke validated source quality but missed the source-to-deploy disconnect.

## What needs to change in substrate

Substrate convention: when an arc adds a new file under substrate/templates/ or substrate/skills/ or any other install.sh-deployed location, the arc's Phase C (smoke) MUST include a beat that verifies install.sh dry-run lists the new file in its deploy plan. Concrete shape:

For each new substrate file the arc adds (templates, skills, etc.):
- Beat: 'bash substrate/install.sh --dry-run --target project --project-dir <test-dir> | grep <new-file-name>' returns at least one match.
- Beat: same for --target subproject and --target user.
- Acceptance: each new file appears in the deploy plan output for every applicable target mode.

If the file does NOT appear, install.sh's hardcoded list (TEMPLATE_NAMES, CAPTAIN_NAMES, SKILL_NAMES, or similar) needs updating in the same arc — surface as a Phase C SMOKE FAIL with the exact missing file name + install.sh fix needed.

## Where in substrate

1. **substrate/MAJOR_PLINY.md** — gauntlet-discipline section that lists smoke-beat conventions. Add the install.sh-deploy-plan check as a required smoke-beat class for arcs that add new substrate files.

2. **operating-disciplines.md** — could add a 'Substrate-edit smoke beats' subsection that documents this discipline at the universal-team level (CAPTAIN_VERA + CAPTAIN_ZENO would benefit from explicit guidance).

3. **Substrate templates** — if a substrate-arc-directive template exists (or future arc-directive-template lands), include the install.sh-deploy beat in the template's Phase C smoke section.

## Sequencing

Could fold into arc-22 (which already has stoa--e39, stoa--kjo, stoa--cgn queued) as the 'substrate-process discipline cleanup' batch. Or file as standalone — POLYBIUS_the_stoa's call.

## Reference

- Arc 21 commit e2d8b63 (the substrate-add-without-deploy-list-update bug)
- Inline fix commit 51397da (install.sh: add 3 arc-21 templates to TEMPLATE_NAMES)
- Arc 21 directive Phase C smoke beats (substrate/arcs/arc-21-build-directive.md, beats 7-8 — content-only; missing deploy-plan beat)
- ariadne-core-workspace commit db17e88 (the post-fix propagation that finally landed the full substrate)
title: Smoke beats for new substrate files MUST include install.sh dry-run deploy-plan check
